[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Mastering Postman Workspaces: Personal, Team, and Private"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Postman workspaces allow you to organize your API development projects and collaborate with teammates effectively. Choosing the right workspace type is essential for managing visibility, access control, and productivity."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Understanding Workspace Types"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Personal Workspaces: Visible only to you. Ideal for individual experimentation, learning, and drafting local API requests."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Team Workspaces: Visible to all members of your Postman team. Perfect for collaborative API development, shared collections, and environments."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Private Workspaces: Available on enterprise plans, visible only to invited team members. Best for sensitive APIs or work-in-progress projects requiring restricted access."},{"order":7,"type":"subheading","text":"Creating a New Workspace"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"To create a workspace in Postman, click on the "Workspaces" dropdown in the top left corner and select "Create Workspace"."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"1. Open Postman desktop app.
2. Click 'Workspaces' -> 'Create Workspace'.
3. Choose between Personal, Team, or Private.
4. Enter a name and summary.
5. Click 'Create'."},{"order":10,"type":"subheading","text":"Best Practices for Workspace Management"},{"order":11,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Keep Personal workspaces clean and use them as staging grounds before moving stable collections to Team workspaces."},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use descriptive naming conventions for Team workspaces to reflect specific projects or microservices."},{"order":13,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Leverage Private workspaces when dealing with production credentials or proprietary business logic."}]
